title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Issues concerning the Application of Paragraph 2 of Article 225 of the Criminal Procedure Law

articles.content_en: I. For a case where the Supreme People's Court, pursuant to Article 239 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 353 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, renders a ruling disapproving the death sentence and remands the case to the second-instance people's court for retrial, regardless of whether the second-instance people's court has previously remanded the case for retrial on the grounds that the original judgment had unclear facts or insufficient evidence, in principle, the case shall not be remanded again to the first-instance people's court for retrial; if there are special circumstances that indeed require remand to the first-instance people's court for retrial, approval from the Supreme People's Court shall be obtained.

II. For a case where the Supreme People's Court renders a ruling disapproving the death sentence and remands it to the second-instance people's court for retrial, if the second-instance people's court, based on the special circumstances of the case, again remands the case to the first-instance people's court for retrial, after the first-instance people's court renders a judgment, if the defendant files an appeal or the people's procuratorate files a protest, the second-instance people's court shall render a judgment or ruling according to law, and shall not remand the case for retrial again.
This is the reply.
